d:
Bihar ki mitti pratibhaon se bhari pari hai yahan ki kalakritiyan desh duniya men prasiddh hain. yahan ke kaee aartist aise hain jinhonne apni alag pahchan banaee hai. inhin men ek ramchandr ram bhi hain jo bainbu aarts ke lie bare prasiddh kalakar mane jate hain. apni kala se manav chitr banana unki khas pahchan hai. unke dvara banae gae samanon ki mang desh duniya tak phaili huee hai.
